lines.zh: 绿色翅膀在叶间几乎看不见
lines.en: Green wings nearly vanish among leaves.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶滑到另一片
lines.en: I slip from leaf to leaf.
I fly low along the vines.

lines.zh: 翅膀的边缘带一点深色
lines.en: My wing edges carry a darker shade.
I pass through a slant of light.

lines.zh: 我飞过一朵还没开的花
lines.en: I pass a flower not yet open.
I turn a corner under the canopy.

lines.zh: 我扇得很轻，像叶子在动
lines.en: My beat is light, like a leaf stirring.
I head for a patch of light.
My color is much like the moss.
I fly to the canopy's edge.
A gust comes and I glide down it.
I pass through the middle of a fern.

lines.zh: 我在叶面上停了一下又走
lines.en: I touch a leaf's face and move on.
I slide down a vine.
I swing around a spent flower.

lines.zh: 我停在一片有水的叶上
lines.en: I rest on a leaf holding water.

lines.zh: 我的绿色在湿叶上更亮
lines.en: My green brightens on the wet leaf.
I hold one foreleg up.

lines.zh: 藤蔓在我旁边绕了三圈
lines.en: The vine winds three times beside me.

lines.zh: 林下的光斑在我身上移
lines.en: A patch of light moves over me.
I open and close my wings slowly.
An ant passes my feet.
I walk two steps along the vein.
I spread my wings on the leaf.
The water tastes faint.
The understory air is still.
I lift my head suddenly.

lines.zh: 我在苔上停着，你差点没看见
lines.en: I rest on the moss; you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 我的绿色在这片林子里真管用
lines.en: My green truly serves me in this wood.

lines.zh: 我的绿翅膀在叶间一闪。
lines.en: My green wings flash between the leaves.

lines.zh: 我翅上的绿，和叶子一样。
lines.en: My green wings match the leaves.
I move to a branch that catches the sun.
I rest on a poppy and look at you.
You reach out and I change leaves.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一片叶子
lines.en: There is one leaf between us.

lines.zh: 我就在你手边这片叶上
lines.en: I am on the leaf right by your hand.
Your breathing is louder than the wind.
A crease runs across my wing.
I land on a leaf and dare not move.
Mud has covered my green.
I beat my wings several times to rise.
I crawl to the leaf's underside.
A crease has formed in my wing.
I press along a leaf vein.
My wingbeat has gone uneven.
I try to fly, and cannot rise.
I burrow deeper into the leaves.
That flower over there is half open.
I follow the scent across.
You hold nothing in your hand.
Not much nectar here, but enough for me.

lines.zh: 我落下去，脚先碰到花瓣
lines.en: I land, feet touching the petal first.
I sip the nectar slowly.

lines.zh: 我停在这朵花上不想走
lines.en: I stay on this flower, unwilling to leave.
I know the color of that flower.
I fly a little closer to look.
Hold the flower higher and I must fly.
I dive into the leaves.

lines.zh: 你一动，我撞上你的袖口
lines.en: You move and I hit your cuff.
A tendril scrapes my wing.
I flip once before righting myself.
Wing dust falls on your hand.
I retreat behind a leaf.
I bump your hand, very lightly.
Your movement carries me off line.
I steady myself at the leaf's edge.
My wing passes between your fingers.
A green one waits beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 我们的颜色一样，很难分清
lines.en: We are the same color and hard to tell apart.
She lifts off and I follow.

lines.zh: 我们在同一朵花上停了一下
lines.en: We both rest on one flower.

lines.zh: 她的翅膀比我的窄一点
lines.en: Her wings are a little narrower.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一根藤飞了两圈
lines.en: We circle a vine twice.

lines.zh: 我们停在一片叶的两端
lines.en: We rest at both ends of one leaf.

lines.zh: 她绕着我的头顶飞了一圈
lines.en: She circles above my head once.

lines.zh: 我们一起落进同一束光
lines.en: We land in the same shaft of light.
She moves, and so do I.
I drop down and hug it with my legs.
Too heavy; I cannot lift it.
I touch it with my proboscis.
Neither flower nor nectar.
I let go and it falls on the leaf.
I stand somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我在它旁边站了一会儿
lines.en: I stand beside it a while.
I turn it over with a leg.
There is a small bug under it; I step aside.

lines.zh: 这不是花蜜，我松开爪子。
lines.en: This is not nectar, so I let go.
I stop where two veins cross.
My green means I need not hide.

lines.zh: 你从这边过来，我看见了
lines.en: You come from that side; I saw.
I move to a higher leaf.
I lift off the moss.

lines.zh: 我在你的视野边上停住
lines.en: I stop at the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 我的颜色替我藏了一半
lines.en: My color hides half of me.
You are searching; I am watching.
I am only one leaf away.
When you move, I move.
I follow you, never flying high.

lines.zh: 你的帽子上落了一片叶
lines.en: A leaf has fallen on your hat.

lines.zh: 我停在你看不见的那一侧
lines.en: I rest on the side you cannot see.

lines.zh: 我不出声，翅膀也慢下来
lines.en: I go silent, and my wings slow.

lines.zh: 我一直在你旁边那丛蕨里
lines.en: I stay in the fern beside you.
Your steps crackle the dead leaves.
I fly below your line of sight.
You stop, and I settle on a leaf.
I go around to the lit side.
I will not fly far.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，没什么分量
lines.en: I lunge, and there is no weight to it.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖蹭过你的鬓角。
lines.en: My wingtip brushes your temple.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你脸上停了一瞬
lines.en: My legs rest on your face a moment.
I hurry away from there.
I bump my head against your cheek.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你鼻梁上停了一下
lines.en: My legs rest on your nose a moment.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，翅打在你眼下
lines.en: I lunge, wing striking under your eye.

lines.zh: 我这一下连风都搅不动
lines.en: This blow cannot even stir the air.
I withdraw behind a leaf.
I circle back once more.

lines.zh: 我从一片湿叶下面爬出
lines.en: I crawl out from under a wet leaf.
My green has just come through.
I rest on the moss a long while.

lines.zh: 林下的光正好落在叶上
lines.en: The understory light falls just right.
I walk away from the casing.
I wait for my wings to harden, then fly.
I squeeze out through a leaf gap.
My wings are still curled.
I pause on the moss.
The understory damp is just right.

lines.zh: 热气把我的翅边烤得发脆
lines.en: The heat makes my wing edges brittle.

lines.zh: 我从叶上滑下去，一路翻
lines.en: I slide off the leaf, tumbling.
The water on the leaf holds me fast.

lines.zh: 爆风把叶子和我也掀了
lines.en: The blast throws the leaves and me.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过叶子，擦过我
lines.en: Something passes through the leaf and grazes me.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的翅发抖
lines.en: That force sets my wings trembling.
Nectar is scarce and my flight lacks strength.

lines.zh: 雷光透过树冠，我贴在叶上
lines.en: Lightning shows through the canopy; I press to the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子没有了，我直直落下去
lines.en: The leaves are gone; I fall straight down.
